organization: International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC)
description:
What we do
 
Since 1863, the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) has worked to preserve human dignity and relieve suffering caused by war and armed violence.In collaboration with our Red Cross and Red Crescent partners around the world, we do everything we can to deliver life-saving aid, reconnect families and locate missing people – helping those who need it most, regardless of who they are and what side of the front line they are on.We engage with authorities and armed forces on all sides, often confidentially, pressing for access to detainees to improve their living conditions and urging compliance with international humanitarian law to protect non-combatants, including from digital threats.
 Purpose
 
The Premises Maintenance Supervisor ensures proper maintenance of ICRC premises and equipment and supervises the maintenance team.
 Relationships
 

Internally, interacts with other ICRC employees and/or the users of ICRC premises.
Externally, interacts with suppliers and service providers

 Accountabilities & functional responsibilities
 
Premises Maintenance supervision
 

Coordinates maintenance activities, i.e., organizes schedules, plans, and assigns work activities to the Technicians according to priorities, and performs himself/herself part of these activities themselves
Evaluates, determines, and controls material, equipment, and supplies to be used by Technicians; prepares bills of quantities or work specifications when needed
Plans and conducts regular visits to ICRC premises in all sites including the sub delegations and offices ; proactively evaluates premises fixtures and systems, determines the cause of malfunctioning, and proposes, organizes, and performs preventive maintenance when applicable
Deals with external service providers and suppliers were relevant; Coordinates and inspects outsourced maintenance and renovation work
Participates in the selection of new premises (offices, residences, warehouses), in inspection and confirmation of the functionality of utilities, ESAP concerns and structure as per ICRC standard
Proposes revision of maintenance work and/or procedures

 
Security Management
 

Ensures a safe and secure environment around all the premises
Ensures that ICRC standard safety policies, guidelines, and standards are followed by Technicians
In coordination with the Field Team Coordinator, ensures that passive security measures are in place and proposes corrective actions when necessary
Records and investigates premises-related accidents and prepares relevant reports
Ensures the proper installation and functionality of security equipment in all premises (i.e., razor wire, fire extinguishers, smoke detectors, gas detectors, signs, fire blanket, 3M film, etc.)
Lead the implementation of ESAP projects across all compounds to ensure compliance with ICRC standards.
Serve as the primary focal person for ESAP projects within the ET delegation, coordinating with the sub-delegation technician to ensure all work aligns with ESAP standards, and prepare comprehensive reports for submission to the LON team.

 
 
 Team supervision 
 

Participates in the selection and recruitment of Technicians part of the Maintenance team
Plans, supervises, and follows up on the Technicians' performance and ensures that the quality of maintenance service delivery complies with ICRC policies and standards
Supervises, coaches, and guides the Maintenance team and prioritizes and assigns tasks on a day-to-day basis
Ensures that the maintenance team is adequately trained and motivated; conducts regular on-the-job training on maintenance and repair standard procedures
Oversee vacation plans and schedules the utilization of annual leave by Maintenance team members; ensures timely assignment of replacements
Participates in conflict management
Participates in updating Job Descriptions and conducting performance reviews for Maintenance team members
Hire daily workers when necessary
Develops and maintains a pleasant working atmosphere and a conducive working environment within the team and with other colleagues
Participates in internal meetings
Ensures effective information flow within the unit.

 
Premises Maintenance request management
 

Acts as a focal point for maintenance requests, offering statistical overviews and technical analysis when requested
Monitors’ maintenance requests progress and ensures efficient accomplishment of the tasks; provides timely feedback to the requesters
Premises Management (in coordination with the Premises Manager) 
 

Monitors and controls expenses and service costs related to maintenance.
Participates in tenders and selection of contractors for maintenance and renovation work on the premises
In liaison with concerned Logistics units initiate and supervise ordering and purchase of necessary material, supplies, and maintenance-related stock.
In coordination with Technicians, keeps record of the tools and replaces damaged items; makes sure the tools inventory list is alway
